item.title: Bulletin updated at 07:45 HKT 26/Apr/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
An anticyclone aloft will strengthen in the next few days. The weather will be generally fine and remain hot over the coastal areas of southern China. The northeast monsoon will reach the coast of Guangdong early next week. Besides, a tropical cyclone may form over the central to southern parts of the South China Sea during the weekend, and there are uncertainties in its movement and intensity. The weather is expected to be windy with more showers, and the temperatures will be slightly lower over the coast of southern China next Sunday and Monday.
